findings.source_phrase: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
findings.question: Does the white disc correspond to the original DVD, rather than being an additional disc while the original remains?
findings.criteria: Compare the source and edited scenes for the original DVD's location and continuity. Pass only if the original DVD has been transformed into the white disc; fail if the original remains and a separate white disc has been added; unknown if correspondence cannot be determined.
findings.evidence: The source shows a small rectangular DVD case near the center and a dark object to its right. The edited image shows a white disc near the center and another white disc to the right; the right-hand disc appears to occupy the dark object's location, while the central case is no longer visible.
findings.rationale: The existing identity check relies on disc shape and location, but does not resolve whether the requested DVD was transformed or whether a new disc was introduced while the original DVD/case disappeared. This correspondence check is needed to judge the requested transformation faithfully.
